text: Rejected options (2026-11-26): the official soniox Python SDK (we need our own deadline and cleanup, plain requests is easier to mock, and the first uv run downloads less within the 30 s limit); a shared module between the two tools (it needs sys.path changes, so about 20 duplicated lines were accepted instead); a base-URL config (region selects both the api and tts-rt hosts); checking file extensions before upload (Soniox detects the format, and Signal attachments can have odd extensions); a client-side 5000-character check (Soniox already returns a clear 400); a watchdog deadline on in-flight requests (live transcription of a 67 s clip took about 2 s).
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>

text: Stavros chose these defaults on 2026-11-26: default_voice Sebastian, default_language en, language_hints el,en (he sends voice notes that mix Greek and English). The TTS parameter is 'voice', not ElevenLabs' 'voice_id'. Stavros accepted that this breaks drop-in compatibility because Soniox voices are names. text_to_speech also takes an optional 'language' that ElevenLabs does not have: the language field sets the accent for the whole clip, and the assistant knows which language it wrote.
author: Stavros Korokithakis <hi@stavros.io>
